!! Interview Experience PayPal: Data Engineer Role – 4 Rounds !!

📌 Round 1: Technical – DSA + SQL (45 mins)
Data Structures & Algorithms:
• Rainwater Trapping – optimized for space and time
• Priority Queue-based problem for task scheduling
• Array traversal using prefix sums and sliding window patterns

SQL:
• Extensive use of window functions – ROW_NUMBER, RANK, LAG, LEAD
• Aggregations, partitions, and advanced joins
• Query optimization and performance tuning techniques

📌 Round 2: Technical Design + PySpark (45–60 mins)
Project-Based Discussion:
• Shared architecture of prior data pipelines
• Justified choices of tools like Airflow, Glue, Kafka, Snowflake
• Discussed strategies for data validation, monitoring, and scalability

System Design Scenario:
• Data migration from Hadoop, Oracle DB, and S3 → unified S3 data lake
• Focused on scalability, error handling, schema management, and fault tolerance

Spark Coding Task:
• DataFrame joins and transformations in PySpark
• Handled edge cases like null values, schema mismatches, and skewed data
• Output written in partitioned Parquet format

📌 Round 3: Managerial + Scenario-Based (60 mins)
• In-depth discussion on project ownership and collaboration with cross-functional teams
• Real-time problem scenarios like pipeline delays, replication lags, and Spark job failures
• Behavioral focus: adaptability, leadership under pressure, and communication

📌 Round 4: HR Discussion
• Offer structure, benefits, and company policies
• Discussion on organizational values and career progression opportunities
• Cultural alignment and long-term vision

Key Takeaways:
• The interview process was balanced across technical, design, and behavioral areas
• Strong emphasis on SQL, PySpark, and scalable data pipeline design
• Communication, clarity in thought, and structured problem-solving played a key role

If you're preparing for Data Engineering roles, focus on core fundamentals, hands-on tool experience, and articulating the why behind your decisions.
